note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The decision carries ONLY editable placeholder text; the one supplied difference is which of the party's two neutral labels (equal weight) is attached to the same located section. No grounds catalogue, admissibility, time limit, standard of review, evaluation of any section, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn.
